title: LaralCN-UI registry entry
description: Schema for a single component.json registry entry. Every registry/components/<name>/component.json MUST validate against this.

name.description: Unique component identifier, kebab-case. Matches the directory name and the installed file base name.

type.description: component = single UI primitive; block = composed multi-file pattern; theme = token set only.

dependencies.description: Dependency closure. Omitted arrays are treated as empty.

components.description: Other LaralCN-UI components this one requires (resolved recursively by ui:add).

js.description: npm packages the consumer must install (e.g. alpinejs). Reported, never auto-installed.

composer.description: Composer packages the consumer must install. Effectively always includes gehrisandro/tailwind-merge-laravel.

files.description: Files written into the consumer's components_path.

path.description: Target path relative to the configured components_path, e.g. button.blade.php.

source.description: Path of the source file within this component's registry directory, e.g. files/button.blade.php.

tailwind.description: Theme tokens / CSS variables the component expects to exist (provided by ui:init or the theming page).
